verdict.rationale: Superhuman's engineering blog states the app "works perfectly offline" and works even on a terrible connection, and its search write-up says search shouldn't require a network connection. Together these cover offline reading and offline search. Offline composing and syncing changes on reconnect are only implied by the general offline claim, not described specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of writing/sending email offline, explicit description of queued changes syncing on reconnect, and independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
